messages:
Sasha_Partnerships: Countdown thread for Marketplace launch next Fri. Need to finalize: regional embargo staggering, HW partner certification slots, SI onboarding webinar, marketplace SKU tags for partners, and landing page translation cadence.
Noor_Marketing: We want staged press: NA first (Fri 09:00 PT), EU stagger +2h, APAC next morning local time. That avoids cross-region spikes. Need final product blurb + two partner quotes by Wed EOD.
Troy_Legal: Agree with staged embargo. Legal notes: partner logos need signed asset release; also check any co-marketing language for compliance. I'll upload the asset-release template to the drive and flag any risky phrases.
Hector_Eng: For partner onboarding we need to expose a tenant-tagging param so partner SKUs map to partner accounts. Small API change: add "partner_ref" query param on /v1/catalog/create. Can ship patch to staging today.
Maya_SI: Webinar: propose Thu 11:00 PT for partner SIs, include a 20-min demo + 25-min hands-on lab. Need partner dev tokens and a short troubleshooting cheat sheet (auth, quota, cold-start). Also request perf note for image-gen and chat routes.
Liam_Product: Landing page plan: support i18n for EN/FR/DE/JP. Marketing to ship copy by Thu noon so localization can turn around by Thu EOB. Also add UTM/referral param for partner tracking.
Noor_Marketing: Design asked about hero variants: technical vs ecosystem. We'll A/B and measure click-to-signup. Also need CDN purge window immediately post-prod.
Hector_Eng: Token snippet for partner staging cluster:
```
POST /api/partner_tokens
{
  "env": "partner-staging",
  "scopes": ["catalog:read","deploy:invoke","billing:read"],
  "expires_in": 86400
}
```
Use header: Authorization: Bearer <service-token>.
Maya_SI: Perfect. I'll validate tokens during the webinar lab. Will prepare the checklist.
Troy_Legal: Reminder on quotes: no future feature promises, avoid SLA commitments in public copy. I can sign off quick at Wed AM if drafts follow those rules.
Sasha_Partnerships: HW certification slots: we have three 60-min slots Tue/Wed/Thu 14:00-15:00 PT. @Noor_Marketing confirm which partners need priority testing and I'll reserve.
Noor_Marketing: Prioritize PartnerA and EdgeCloud. Also collect high-res logos (SVG) but wait for signed asset-release.
DeployBot: Deploy window: marketplace-catalog v2024-07-12 -> production 2024-07-12T09:00:00Z. Watch #release-war-room for logs and post-deploy health checks.
Sasha_Partnerships: Action summary: 1) @Hector_Eng ship partner_ref param + perf note to staging (today). 2) @Noor_Marketing deliver hero + partner quotes (Wed EOD). 3) @Troy_Legal upload asset-release + approve quotes (Wed AM). 4) @Maya_SI prep webinar lab + checklist (Thu) and validate partner tokens. 5) I'll calendar HW cert slots and share invites. Any obs/blocks? :rocket:
